info.name: The Little Prince that Loves Roses

descriptions.notStarted: There was a strange boy in the middle of the Nihal Desert. Dressed unlike those in the desert, with a blonde hair that matched the color of the sand... I better go to #b#m260010500##k and talk to him.
descriptions.inProgress: The strange boy seemed concerned about his wilting rose. A rose? Who cares about a rose? I'm more concerned about you sitting in the middle of the desert like this. Anyway, I better get him some #b#t2022155##k for his roses... but more so for him. \n\n#i2022155# #t2022155#  #b#c2022155##k/5
descriptions.completed: I gave the strange boy some #t2022155#. He smiled a smile of relief. Who is this kid anyway? What's he doing here?
